dsh-xiangqi is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-051d6a91ffd395cc1fbc.html
